tool.name: ParaFEM Sensor to BC Schedule
tool.description: Convert InfluxDB sensor CSV to time-varying BC schedule (.bcs)

param.name: mesh_d
param.label: Mesh geometry (.d)
param.help: ParaFEM .d file from mesh generator or mesh import tool

param.name: sensor_csv
param.label: Sensor readings CSV
param.help: CSV from InfluxDB with elapsed_seconds column and temperature columns

param.name: zone_template
param.label: Zone Template (JSON)
param.help: JSON array mapping CSV column names to mesh zones (axis-based or NSET-based).

param.name: dtim
param.label: Time step size (seconds)
param.help: Divides elapsed_seconds to compute the step index

param.name: nset_file
param.label: Node sets (.nset)
param.help: Input .nset file from ParaFEM Mesh Import tool

tool.help:
Converts an InfluxDB sensor CSV file into a ParaFEM time-varying boundary condition schedule (.bcs) file.
The CSV must contain an ``elapsed_seconds`` column and one or more temperature columns. Each row is mapped to a simulation time step using: ``step = round(elapsed_seconds / dtim)``. Rows with step == 0 are skipped.
The Zone Template is a JSON array where each entry maps a CSV column to a mesh zone. For axis-based zones::
[ {"col_name": "upstream_temp", "axis_min": 0.0, "axis_max": 0.1}, {"col_name": "downstream_temp", "axis_min": 0.9, "axis_max": 1.0} ]
For NSET-based zones::
[ {"col_name": "upstream_temp", "nset_name": "UPSTREAM_FACE"}, {"col_name": "downstream_temp", "nset_name": "DOWNSTREAM_FACE"} ]
The output `.bcs` file can be used by the GDPS Transient Thermal Solver.
